Featured case study

A clearer journey from application to decision

A portfolio case study that connects business needs to practical delivery and reporting outputs.

The scope covers application capture, mandatory-field validation, document readiness, assignment, manual review, decision recording, notifications, audit history, and operational KPIs.

Simulated portfolio case study. The proposed system and its benefits are designed outcomes, not a deployed bank platform or measured production results.

Project at a glance

Business Analysisdraw.ioJiraSQL ServerExcelPower BI
  • Role: Business & Data Analyst
  • Data: 120 simulated records, Jan–Mar 2026
  • Delivery: 8 epics, 12 stories, 3 planned sprints
  • Scope: Analysis, process design, planning and reporting
Business problem

Disconnected manual tracking

  • Paper applications and repeated document follow-up.
  • Unclear case ownership and review priorities.
  • Inconsistent status and decision records.
  • Limited visibility into pending applications.
Proposed direction

Centralized, traceable workflow

  • Structured intake with completeness checks.
  • Document checklist and missing-information loop.
  • Assigned review queue with recorded decisions.
  • Status history, notifications and KPI reporting.

Acceptance criteria example · US-08

As a loan officer, I want to record an approval or decline decision so that the application has a clear outcome.

  • The decision requires a valid reason category.
  • The system records the decision date and user.

Data work

Cleaning, validation, modeling, and SQL analysis

SQL setup & cleaningSQL analysisClean dataset

Data-quality checks

The supplied analysis dataset contains 120 applications and nine fields. Application IDs are unique; required values are present. The cleaning script documents type conversion, validation and controlled categories.

The supplied raw and clean CSV files contain the same records. This case does not claim a measured reduction in duplicates or errors.

Field groupExample fields
IdentifiersApplication_ID, Customer_ID
Application detailsSubmitted_Date, Requested_Amount_JOD, Term_Months
Profile and statusEmployment_Type, Current_Status
Operational trackingTurnaround_Days, Current_or_Decision_Reason

SQL analysis · 10 business questions

  1. Executive KPIs
  2. Application status distribution
  3. Decision outcomes and reasons
  4. Requested amount by employment type
  5. Approval rate by employment type
  6. Requested amount bands
  7. Loan-term analysis
  8. Queue-aging exceptions
  9. Monthly volume and outcomes
  10. Month-over-month application change
